import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
V = 'vendor/tcg-engines'; SRC = '.local/rule-01/upstream'
lock = json.load(open(V + '/upstream.lock.json'))
rev = lock['revision']
assert rev == '53a79413c58678b1c50dde57e71de5c123132716', rev
head = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', SRC, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
assert head == rev, 'pinned checkout HEAD ' + head
def blob(path):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', SRC, 'cat-file', 'blob', rev + ':' + path], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
def gitsha(b):
    return hashlib.sha1(b'blob %d\0' % len(b) + b).hexdigest()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
patches = {}
for p in lock['patches']:
    patches.setdefault(p['path'], []).append(p)
assert len(lock['patches']) == 28 and len({p['id'] for p in lock['patches']}) == 28
identical = patched = 0
for row in lock['files']:
    pinned = blob(row['upstream_path']); local = open(V + '/' + row['path'], 'rb').read()
    assert gitsha(pinned) == row['git_blob'] and sha(pinned) == row['upstream_sha256'], row['path']
    assert sha(local) == row['sha256'] and len(local) == row['bytes'], row['path']
    if row['path'] in patches:
        text = pinned.decode('utf8')
        for p in patches[row['path']]:
            assert text.count(p['before']) == 1, ('anchor', p['id'])
            text = text.replace(p['before'], p['after'])
            assert open(V + '/' + p['original_path'], 'rb').read() == pinned, ('original', p['id'])
        assert text.encode('utf8') == local, ('patched bytes', row['path'])
        patched += 1
    else:
        assert local == pinned, ('changed unpatched', row['path'])
        identical += 1
assert set(patches) <= {r['path'] for r in lock['files']}
listed = {r['path'] for r in lock['files']}
present = set()
for d, _, fs in os.walk(V + '/upstream'):
    for f in fs:
        present.add(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d, f), V))
assert present == listed, ('extra', sorted(present - listed)[:5], 'missing', sorted(listed - present)[:5])
for lic in lock['licenses']:
    b = blob(lic['upstream_path'])
    assert open(V + '/' + lic['path'], 'rb').read() == b and gitsha(b) == lic['git_blob'], lic['path']
tests = [r for r in lock['files'] if r['scope'] == 'test_only' and r['path'].endswith('.test.ts')]
assert all(r['path'] not in patches for r in tests)
assert len(lock['tests']) == 27 and all(('upstream/' + t) in listed and ('upstream/' + t) not in patches for t in lock['tests'])
assert 'seedrandom' not in lock['runtime_externals']
print(json.dumps({'files': len(listed), 'identical': identical, 'patched_files': patched, 'patches': 28,
                  'licenses': len(lock['licenses']), 'selected_tests_unchanged': len(lock['tests']),
                  'runtime_externals': lock['runtime_externals'], 'extra_or_missing': 0}))
print('PASS independent git cat-file byte audit of pinned vendor tree and 28-patch ledger')
summary: Independent RULE-03 audit: separate Python git cat-file byte audit of the 347-file vendor tree, 28-patch ledger (single anchors, originals equal pinned blobs), licenses, 27 unchanged selected tests and no extra/missing files
